text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Ines! Been a minute! Guess you're back
to your
old shift schedule.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, yeah, sorry! I hope this place wasn't
too
short-staffed without me?

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
No wayyy! I'm happy you took that time
off! I was
worried you were literally
going to work till you
dropped.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Lemme know if you ever need me to
cover a shift.
Y'know, like, when you
have practice and stuff.
Oh, and any
time you feel like working, you're

welcome to my shifts too.

text_block_list.name: Flashy Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do anything I can to help you
out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I've already adjusted your shift
schedule for
March. Make sure you rest
up after the Osaka
Hai."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Watching you run gives us hope, Ines."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
First my coworker and now my boss...
Everyone's
getting ahead of themselves
trying to
accommodate me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha. C'mon, all this talk of hopes and
dreams is a
little much, don't you think?
choice_data_list: それだけみんな、君に夢を見ている
それだけみんな、貴方に夢を見ている
choice_data_list_en: That's how big of a dream everyone sees in you.
That's how big of a dream everyone sees in you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I do want to be able to pay them back
for all their
support, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list_en: I'll be looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keep those expectations high! I'll
take
them with me to the track!
